## ConnectionConfig.ssl property

Connect over TLS. Postgres/MySQL only.

**Signature:**

```typescript
ssl?: boolean;
```

## Default Value

`false`

## Remarks

Enabling this does not verify the server certificate — it is meant for hosted databases that require an encrypted socket, not as a substitute for a properly pinned CA.
